title.en: Getting Started: Your First Egg and Photocard

description.en: Follow the tutorial arrows from your base to an egg and back to a hatch slot.

intro.en: Follow the tutorial arrows from your base to an egg and back to a hatch slot.

body.en: The reviewed first-session recording begins with a Steal an egg! objective and red route arrows. The marked egg target also shows a distance. Follow the route from your base toward the mascot area.

title.en: 1. Follow the Steal an egg objective

paragraphs.en: The reviewed first-session recording begins with a Steal an egg! objective and red route arrows. The marked egg target also shows a distance. Follow the route from your base toward the mascot area.

The game allows stealing from mascots and other players according to the official description. Use the tutorial’s marked target for a first run, and read the nearby interaction prompt when you reach the egg.

title.en: 2. Bring the egg back to your base

paragraphs.en: After collection, the objective becomes Bring the egg back to your base! A house marker and distance identify the return route. The player visibly carries the egg above the avatar.

Head to your own marked base. Keep watching the objective so that you do not confuse another player’s display area with your destination. Exact penalties for being caught are not established by these frames.
At the base, Place down your egg! replaces the return objective. Use an available hatch position and follow its prompt. The tutorial then displays Wait for your egg to hatch with a countdown.
This confirms that carrying an egg home and starting incubation are separate actions. If the return objective remains visible, check that you reached the marked base and actually placed the egg.
The first egg continues its countdown while the player uses the treadmill. Later, photocards stand on the base slots and show an income rate.
Use that waiting period to build Speed, then inspect the finished hatch. The next guides cover treadmill upgrades, displayed cards and route selection.

title.en: Stand on the treadmill and watch Speed

paragraphs.en: In the mobile recording, the player steps onto the treadmill and repeated shoe icons show +2 gains. The Speed counter rises while the character remains on the belt.
Use a treadmill your account can access. Check the live gain and counter before leaving the character there; standing nearby alone does not prove training has started.
An Upgrade panel beside the treadmill shows the next level and price. Later footage shows +5 gains on the treadmill. This demonstrates a higher observed training gain after progression.
Read the cash price and new level before buying. After purchase, get back on the belt and compare the gain shown on screen. Recorded costs can change with game updates.

title.en: Use area recommendations as a warning

paragraphs.en: A later route entrance in the recording displays 20K recommended beside a shoe symbol. This is a recommended Speed indicator in that recorded area, not evidence of a universal hard unlock.
If a run feels too slow, return to train and bring back a manageable egg first. The guide does not assume that crossing the sign guarantees an escape or that every area uses the same requirement.

title.en: Hatching Eggs: Placement, Timers and Returns

description.en: Confirm that incubation has started and plan your next action around the visible timer.

intro.en: Confirm that incubation has started and plan your next action around the visible timer.

body.en: The tutorial’s first incubation shows 1m 25s remaining in the reviewed frame. A later egg at the base is labeled Sandeoki Pearl Sanctuary Egg with 3h 05m remaining. Different recorded eggs therefore have different remaining timers.

paragraphs.en: The tutorial’s first incubation shows 1m 25s remaining in the reviewed frame. A later egg at the base is labeled Sandeoki Pearl Sanctuary Egg with 3h 05m remaining. Different recorded eggs therefore have different remaining timers.
Use your own egg’s current countdown. A screenshot of remaining time does not establish its full incubation duration, and these values should not be treated as an all-eggs hatch table.

title.en: Use the waiting time for training

paragraphs.en: The tutorial recording shows the avatar leaving the base and training while its hatch countdown continues. You can use that overlap to improve Speed before the next collection run.
Return to inspect the finished egg and available base positions. The footage does not establish every capacity upgrade, hatch acceleration price or whether incubation continues offline.

title.en: Keep rarity, size and mutation separate

paragraphs.en: The official description advertises rarer eggs, photocards, sizes and mutations. Those are distinct properties. A rare-looking egg alone does not establish the exact card, size or mutation it will produce.
Check the current Index and the egg’s own information for collection progress. A complete verified probability table is unavailable; this guide does not invent odds for rare or divine cards.

title.en: Read the card above its base slot

paragraphs.en: Displayed photocards show their name, rarity, weight and cash per second in the recording. Examples include a Rare Yeosang and an Epic Julie with different displayed rates. These are observations from one session.
Compare the income printed on your current cards when choosing what to display. Rarity alone is an incomplete comparison because size and mutations also exist in this game.

title.en: Check the Pick up card interaction

paragraphs.en: The recorded base shows a Pick up card prompt when the player approaches a displayed photocard. That establishes a way to retrieve the displayed object.

Before moving a valuable card, inspect available base space and the current prompt. The reviewed footage does not establish every replacement, sale or trade-confirmation step, so check the live dialog before confirming.

title.en: Treat offline income as an estimate shown by the game

paragraphs.en: The top of the recorded base screen shows You earn ... /Day offline, and the amount changes as the player progresses. This is visible in-game advertising of offline earnings.

The recording does not establish the maximum offline period, collection rules or formula. Use the actual return reward screen to check what was credited. Avoid treating a displayed daily rate as a guaranteed payout for every absence.

title.en: Trading is supported, but the full flow needs verification

paragraphs.en: The official description mentions trading photocards, and a Trade button appears on the left of the gameplay screen. The reviewed footage does not show a completed trade.
Check both sides of the actual offer and the final confirmation before accepting. This site currently has no verified market value list, mutation multiplier table or trade price calculator.
